author: hdprajwal
abstract: Executes an implementation plan by dispatching a fresh subagent per task with a two-stage review after each — spec compliance first, then code quality — looping until both pass. Covers model selection per task, handling implementer status (DONE / DONE_WITH_CONCERNS / NEEDS_CONTEXT / BLOCKED), and ships three prompt templates (implementer, spec reviewer, code-quality reviewer). Adapted from obra/superpowers' subagent-driven-development skill. Tuned to hdprajwal's actual workflow (branch → PR → merge loop, specs in docs/, pnpm + cargo, runtime-proof verification, short plain prose) based on usage analysis.
